What is a digital save the date?

A digital save the date is an early online announcement of an event's date and location, shared by link, text or QR code. It lets guests plan travel and time off before the full invitation arrives.

With MyInviteQR you do not need to send two separate things: publish once and update the same invitation as details are confirmed.

Free to design and preview. Pay once only when you publish.

Tips for save the dates

  • Send wedding save the dates 6 to 9 months ahead, and destination weddings 9 to 12 months ahead.
  • Include the city and date at minimum.
  • Mention that the formal invitation will follow.
  • Add your wedding website if you have one.
  • Include the QR code on printed cards.

Save the date wording ideas

Short and sweet works best.

Save the date. Emma and Jack are getting married on June 14, 2026. Invitation to follow.
Mark your calendar! Sofia turns 30 on October 19.
Save the date for the Northwind Annual Summit, March 12.

Save the date invitation questions

When should I send a save the date?

For weddings, 6 to 9 months ahead is common. For other events, 4 to 8 weeks.

Do I need a separate invitation later?

No. You can update the same invitation, or design a new one if you prefer.

Can I print it?

Yes. Download the QR code and add it to a printed card.

Does it work for birthdays?

Yes. Use it for any event.
